D13's condition is met: P7 shows GitHub opens an empty-commit pull request and starts its required check.

The Dispatch handoff route's request limit is 6 x cap + 4 KiB (not cap + 4 KiB), since JSON string escaping can make each body byte up to six on the wire; the cap itself is enforced on the decoded body.
The pane no longer runs the JJ_USER App-identity check: the daemon checks the record's session, and the merger's @- is the implementer's commit.

The envoy listener still sends changed_paths, changed_paths_truncated and forced on push envelopes; the daemon no longer reads them. Removing them from the listener before the import runs would change how the old daemon classifies the import's removal push, so they stay for the cutover (documented in packages/envoy/AGENTS.md).
openQuestions: Whether to remove changed_paths/changed_paths_truncated/forced from the envoy listener after the cutover completes is the architect's call.
